entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Forehead, brow, cheeks, cheekbones
entries.zh: 额头、眉额、脸颊、颧骨。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Oval, round, square, rectangular, heart-shaped; Wide, broad, full, plump, fleshy; Narrow, long, thin, lean, bony, sunken, hollow; Pointed, sharp, angular; Drooping, sagging
entries.zh: 椭圆、圆、方、长方、心形；宽、宽阔、饱满、圆润、多肉；窄、长、瘦、清瘦、骨感、凹陷、空瘪；尖、锐利、棱角分明；下垂、松弛。

entries.zh: 圆脸女子

entries.zh: 长方脸，额头高而光秃

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She had a long, pointed face like a bird.
entries.zh: 她的脸又长又尖，像鸟的脸。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His once full cheeks were droopy and grey.
entries.zh: 他曾经饱满的脸颊如今松垂而灰暗。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her wide, round face was framed by a mass of curly black hair.
entries.zh: 一头浓密的黑色卷发围着她宽圆的脸。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a very round face and plump hamster cheeks.
entries.zh: 他的脸很圆，两颊鼓得像仓鼠。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was oval-shaped and he had a high, bald forehead.
entries.zh: 他长着椭圆脸，额头高而光秃。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The little girl looked like a cherub with her plump, heart-shaped face and angelic smile.
entries.zh: 小女孩圆润的心形脸上挂着天使般的笑容，像个小天使。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her cheeks looked hollow and the flesh was wrinkled and sagging.
entries.zh: 她的双颊凹陷，皮肉起皱松垂。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her cheekbones were so high, they formed two slashes across her face.
entries.zh: 她的颧骨很高，像两道斜线横在脸上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Bald, with a thin, angular face, his high, sharp cheekbones gave him a haunted look.
entries.zh: 他头顶光秃，脸瘦而棱角分明，高而尖的颧骨让他显得饱受折磨。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Freckles, veins, shadows, bags, circles; Wrinkles, folds, lines, slashes
entries.zh: 雀斑、血管、阴影、眼袋、黑眼圈；皱纹、褶皱、纹路、深刻的划痕状纹路。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Pale, grey, ashen, pallid, deathly, colourless, translucent; Black, brown, olive-skinned; Red, pink, ruddy, bronze-coloured, sunburned, tanned, leathery; Smooth, shiny, glowing; Deep, sharp, vertical
entries.zh: 苍白、灰暗、灰白、惨白、死灰般、毫无血色、半透明；黑、棕、橄榄色皮肤；红、粉红、红润、古铜色、晒伤、晒黑、皮革般粗糙；光滑、发亮、容光焕发；深、尖锐、垂直。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Scrubbed, glowed; Lined, creased, wrinkled, crumpled; Hung, sagged, drooped; Stretched, bulged
entries.zh: 擦洗、发亮；布满纹路、起褶、起皱、皱缩；悬垂、松垂、耷拉；绷紧、鼓起。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 惨白、死灰般的颜色

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Smooth, brown skin
entries.zh: 光滑的棕色皮肤

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Ruddy, glowing face
entries.zh: 红润发亮的脸

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like beaten leather
entries.zh: 像反复捶打过的皮革

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Round, pinkish look of a prize pig
entries.zh: 圆圆粉粉的，像获奖的肥猪

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Dark circles
entries.zh: 黑眼圈

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Purple shadows
entries.zh: 紫色阴影

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 像巨大紫色旅行箱一样的眼袋

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Deep laughter lines in the corners of his eyes and mouth
entries.zh: 眼角和嘴角深深的笑纹

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Sharp, vertical lines
entries.zh: 深刻的竖纹

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Face like thin, crumpled paper
entries.zh: 薄薄皱纸般的脸

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like the skin of a lizard
entries.zh: 像蜥蜴的皮肤

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 满脸褶皱、胡子拉碴

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 眼下皮肤松垂，满是皱纹

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hung in wrinkled folds
entries.zh: 一层层皱褶松垂下来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 紧紧绷在脸上

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gave him a skull-like appearance
entries.zh: 让他看起来像骷髅

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Scrubbed until it glowed
entries.zh: 擦洗得发亮

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Laughter lines burnt into her skin
entries.zh: 深深刻进皮肤的笑纹

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Lines drew together when he smiled
entries.zh: 他微笑时纹路聚拢在一起

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Deeply lined with age
entries.zh: 年岁留下深深的纹路

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Covered in wrinkles
entries.zh: 满是皱纹

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Wrinkles looked like cruel slashes
entries.zh: 皱纹像一道道无情的刀痕

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Eyes were lost within their wrinkles
entries.zh: 眼睛几乎埋在皱纹里

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Lines burrowed between his brows
entries.zh: 双眉之间刻着深纹

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gave him a permanent frown
entries.zh: 让他看上去总在皱眉

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was painfully thin and his face deathly pale.
entries.zh: 他瘦得让人心疼，脸色像死人一样苍白。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was ashen and twisted with pain.
entries.zh: 他的脸灰白，因疼痛而扭曲。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her skin was a sickly, grey colour and hung in wrinkled folds.
entries.zh: 她的皮肤是病态的灰色，一层层皱褶松垂着。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a ruddy face that had been scrubbed until it glowed.
entries.zh: 他的脸红润，擦洗得闪闪发亮。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was crumpled, unshaven and grey with anxiety.
entries.zh: 他满脸皱纹，胡子拉碴，焦虑使他的脸色灰暗。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He looked like a walrus, with huge folds of sagging skin drooping from his face.
entries.zh: 他像一头海象，脸上厚厚的松皮一层层垂下来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her pale skin was translucent. It was almost purple under her eyes and limp and sagging with wrinkles.
entries.zh: 她苍白的皮肤近乎透明，眼下发紫，松软下垂且满是皱纹。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a sallow, scarred face and the haunted look of someone who had seen many battles.
entries.zh: 他面色蜡黄，布满疤痕，神情像历经战火的人一样备受折磨。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: With her pale, almost colourless skin, she looked like a fragile china doll.
entries.zh: 她肤色苍白得几乎没有血色，像个脆弱的瓷娃娃。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His colourless skin was stretched tight over his face and gave him a skull-like appearance.
entries.zh: 他毫无血色的皮肤紧绷在脸上，让他看起来像骷髅。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: There were shadows and bags like giant, purple suitcases under her eyes.
entries.zh: 她的眼下有阴影，还有像巨大紫色旅行箱一样的眼袋。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Sharp, vertical lines burrowed between his brows and gave him a permanent frown.
entries.zh: 深刻的竖纹嵌在双眉之间，使他总像皱着眉头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Laughter lines surrounded her eyes and mouth, burnt by the sun and wind during the hours spent outside with the animals.
entries.zh: 她长时间在户外与动物为伴，风吹日晒把笑纹深深刻在眼角和嘴边。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The years had not been kind to her and decay was obvious in a face covered in wrinkles like thin, crumpled paper.
entries.zh: 岁月对她并不仁慈；那张像揉皱的薄纸一样满是皱纹的脸，显露出衰老的痕迹。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Skull, face, jaw, cheeks, mouth, lip, eye, eyebrows; Skin, flesh, tissue, folds, lumps, patches; Sores, blisters, burns, bruise, wound, scabs; Scar, mole, wart; Width, length
entries.zh: 头骨、脸、下颌、脸颊、嘴、嘴唇、眼睛、眉毛；皮肤、皮肉、组织、褶皱、肿块、斑块；疮、水疱、烧伤、瘀青、伤口、痂；疤痕、痣、疣；宽度、长度。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Red, pink, black, purple, brown, green, yellow, creamy; Wide, thin, huge, small; Jagged, gnarled; Ugly, horrible, grotesque, hideous; Angry, swollen, festering; Peeling, flaking, blotchy
entries.zh: 红、粉红、黑、紫、棕、绿、黄、乳白；宽、细、巨大、小；锯齿状、扭曲粗糙；难看、可怕、怪异丑陋、狰狞；红肿发炎、肿胀、化脓；脱皮、起屑、斑驳。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Scarred, scabbed, burnt, blistered; Ran, covered, stretched, oozed, sprouted; Pulled, dragged, closed, twisted, puckered, disfigured; Scorched, singed, seared, shrivelled
entries.zh: 结疤、结痂、烧伤、起疱；延伸、覆盖、伸展、渗出、长出；拉扯、拖拽、闭合、扭曲、皱缩、毁损容貌；烤焦、燎焦、灼伤、干瘪。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.en: Ugly, wide scar
entries.zh: 难看而宽大的疤痕

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Singed hair and eyebrows
entries.zh: 被燎焦的头发和眉毛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Mass of seared, scarred skin
entries.zh: 一大片灼伤结疤的皮肤

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Blotched, horribly stretched skin
entries.zh: 斑驳且被可怕地拉伸的皮肤

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Puckered, fleshy folds
entries.zh: 皱缩的肉褶

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Gnarled lump of flesh
entries.zh: 一团扭曲粗糙的肉

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Scar above his left eyebrow
entries.zh: 左眉上方的疤痕

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Scarred and twisted lip
entries.zh: 结疤而扭曲的嘴唇

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Had a battle-scarred face
entries.zh: 脸上留着战斗的伤疤

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Disfigured by fire
entries.zh: 被火毁容

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 长出两根粗硬的毛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 渗出乳白色脓液

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Puckered around the wound
entries.zh: 伤口周围皱缩起来

entries.zh: 灼烧成大片粉红色斑块

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shrivelled into a twisted lump of flesh
entries.zh: 萎缩成一团扭曲的肉

entries.zh: 横跨整个下颌

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 从脸的一侧一直延伸下去

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Just visible above left eyebrow
entries.zh: 在左眉上方隐约可见

entries.zh: 覆盖脸部和头骨

entries.zh: 把嘴扯成永远龇牙的模样

entries.zh: 把嘴唇拉到鼻孔旁

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was a mass of sores and peeling skin.
entries.zh: 他的脸上满是疮和脱落的皮屑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The swollen, red blisters twisted his lips into a grimace.
entries.zh: 红肿的水疱使他的嘴唇扭曲成痛苦的表情。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The skin on his face and bald skull was scarred and scabbed.
entries.zh: 他脸上和光秃头顶的皮肤布满疤痕和痂。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a black eye and an angry, purple bruise on his cheek.
entries.zh: 他有一只乌青的眼眶，脸颊上还有一块触目惊心的紫色瘀伤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A thin, jagged scar was just visible above his left eyebrow.
entries.zh: 左眉上方隐约可见一道细细的锯齿状疤痕。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: One of his cheeks was dragged downwards by an ugly scar.
entries.zh: 一道难看的疤痕把他的一侧脸颊往下拉扯。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The scars on his skull were clearly visible through his closely shaved hair.
entries.zh: 透过剃得很短的头发，可以清楚看到他头皮上的伤疤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: One side of his face was a pocked mass of scars and seared skin.
entries.zh: 他半边脸坑坑洼洼，尽是疤痕和灼伤的皮肤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The huge pink mole on her upper lip sprouted two long, gristly hairs.
entries.zh: 她上唇那颗巨大的粉红色痣上，长出两根粗硬的长毛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The left side of his face was terribly burned. It was a mass of seared skin and scorched in huge, pink patches.
entries.zh: 他左半边脸严重烧伤，灼伤的皮肤上有大片粉红色斑块。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The skin was bunched up around the festering, green wound and oozing pus.
entries.zh: 发绿化脓的伤口周围皮肤皱成一团，往外渗着脓液。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The skin around one eye had been pulled out of shape and gave her a curious squint.
entries.zh: 一只眼睛周围的皮肤被拉扯变形，使她呈现出奇怪的斜视。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a scarred and twisted lip, which was pulled up to meet his nostril.
entries.zh: 他的嘴唇结着疤，扭曲着向上牵拉，几乎连到鼻孔。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face had been disfigured by fire. His eyebrows were singed and sprouted at odd angles, and his ear was a shrivelled, gnarled lump.
entries.zh: 火灾毁了他的容貌。眉毛被燎焦，朝奇怪的角度翘着；耳朵萎缩成粗糙扭曲的一团。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was disfigured by a hideous scar that ran the length of one side of his face and pulled his mouth into a permanent snarl.
entries.zh: 一道狰狞的疤痕沿着他半边脸延伸，使他毁了容，嘴也被扯成永远龇牙的模样。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was a mass of scar tissue that almost closed one eye in its puckered folds.
entries.zh: 他满脸都是疤痕组织，皱缩的褶皱几乎挤闭了一只眼睛。
